q.g: A high amount of Tushonka can be found inside the shopping mall on Interchange. Particularly, the "Goshan" (written "гошан" on its signs) supermarket stores a very large amount on its shelves. However, this is a hot-spot for players as many wish to take the Tushonka or loot the registers, so it should be approached with care. * Tushonka is also commonly found in "Ration supply crates" near tanks on Reserve, however like Goshan, Reserve is a highly populated map, with many threats, so it should be approached with care. * Tushonka and other food items are also plentiful at the camp on woods next to scav bunker in a ration supply crate and as loose loot. Farther south, USEC camp is also a good spot to find food items * Tushonka can be crafted in the Hideout at the Nutrition unit Lvl 1.

sh.c: The location of a Ration supply crate next to a tank on Reserve
